clean_body: Addressing what I keep hearing at the doors | | Matt Maasdam is a husband, a father, and a Navy SEAL. He carried the nuclear football for President Obama — now he's running as a Democrat to flip Michigan's 7th congressional district. If you’d like to unsubscribe, | | ** Sorry to interrupt your Saturday. I’m making all kinds of friends knocking doors. Besides this one, nearly all of them had the same concerns. I wanted to take a second to address them. It’s become far too difficult for working people to get by in Michigan. Regardless of background or voting history, the system has been rigged against 99% of us. We’re fed up. Another thing all our neighbors have in common is they’re ready for a candidate unbought by corporate PACs with common sense policies. Our absent Congressman is too far removed from these problems to help. In fact, his campaign profits from it — even if it’s mostly political. We need to get rid of MAGA control of MI-07. Until our government brings solutions for us, I’ll continue fighting to lower costs, get money out of politics, and bring back the Michigan dream. Every day. I’m still here for you. I’m always easy to reach. I’m the fighter Mid-Michigan needs. One who shows up for them, time and time again. ****** | If you've stored your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will process now. | | | | | | Thank you, Matt Maasdam | Follow us on social media! Scott DesJarlais has been in Congress since 2011. In that time he has missed nearly 5% of all votes (more than double the congressional average). He introduced the fewest bills of anyone in the entire Tennessee delegation. He has zero laws passed that have made life better for a single working family in this district.
**But here 's what he didn't miss:**
He didn't miss a single vote to repeal the Affordable Care Act, the healthcare coverage that millions of working Americans depend on. He didn't miss the chance to sign a brief trying to throw out the electoral votes of four states after losing an election fair and square. He didn't miss the opportunity to vote against certifying Arizona and Pennsylvania's results on January 6th... hours after rioters stormed the Capitol in his name. **That 's what we are fighting against, and I need your help.**
[JOIN US HERE!](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/66c7b2a8-b73c-4309-8c39-1c3330830d26?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
He showed up for all of that. Every single time.
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/64e4b03a-cc2b-4afa-b5b1-ed56917fc09e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
My name is Mike Cortese, and I am running against Scott Desjarlais for this exact reason. Time and time again, our communities have paid the price of his silence on the bills he has refused to vote on. _**I 've had enough, because I know our families have had enough too.**_
[DONATE $15 TODAY!](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/66c7b2a8-b73c-4309-8c39-1c3330830d26?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The silence he reserved was specifically for you. For the families who needed someone in their corner on healthcare, on housing, on wages, on the basic indignity of a system that keeps getting harder to survive no matter how hard you work.
That silence has a cost. And this district has been paying it for 14 years. **Can I count on you to join the fight with me?**

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/133283323/627336767/-1080350292?sourceid=1059130&refcode=WUEFER29_20260613_FourGovsRS_ALL&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkNzcxOWY4Ni02MjY3LWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_W0eBOGPWAzfm3JHKpFaAGVW9E8MRM1RasTGMSDtS3E=) Peter, this cycle we launched our State Power Plan to help EMILYs List women build the campaigns they need to take back power in state legislatures, governors' mansions, and key offices across the country.

**1. Gina Hinojosa** — running to unseat Gov. Greg Abbott in Texas: "Texas Republicans can't pass rigged maps next year if they have a governor who will veto them."

**2. Jocelyn Benson **— running to defeat John James in Michigan: "The power of the people will always be greater than the people in power."

**3. Katie Hobbs**— running to hold her seat in Arizona: "My opponent already tried to overturn the 2020 election in Arizona. We can't give him another chance."

**4. Amy Acton** — running to defeat Vivek Ramaswamy in Ohio: "Ohio doesn't need more politicians focused on special interests."

These Democratic women are running to stop Republican extremism, defend our rights, protect our democracy, and deliver for working families. Their wins would be a massive defeat for MAGA Republicans in some of the most consequential races in the country.

But they're up against billionaire Republican mega-donors, outside spending, and nonstop attacks designed to drown out their voices and silence the communities they're fighting for.

body:
I flipped a Republican seat in 2018, and what I’m seeing in Marni’s race reminds me a lot of that.
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/9?t=1&akid=41484%2E3422442%2EUbxW9O)
Hi Peter,
The path to taking back the House runs through California, and one of the most important races will be **Marni von Wilpert in CA-48.**
Marni is the Democratic nominee in San Diego County who can flip a Republican seat this November. **[Can you split a donation between her campaign and Truth to Power to help her win?](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21531?c0=em_ms_ttp_20260613_1_ak.W7YbYw&refcode=em20260613-41484&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=41484%2E3422442%2EUbxW9O)**
[Donate ›››](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21531?c0=em_ms_ttp_20260613_1_ak.W7YbYw&refcode=em20260613-41484&t=3&akid=41484%2E3422442%2EUbxW9O)
At Donald Trump’s order, Republicans across the country gerrymandered congressional seats away from Democrats in a desperate attempt to hold onto power after the midterm elections.
But in California, voters passed Prop 50 to fight back and protect our democracy. **Marni is one of the candidates running in a newly winnable district.** Now, we have to have her back.
Marni is a San Diego City Councilmember who knows how to deliver real results for working families. **She’s running to take on Trump’s chaos and corruption and put an end to ICE’s lawlessness.**
But winning won’t be easy. **Donald Trump and the National Republican Congressional Committee are all in to support the Republican nominee.** _He’s even the highest-raising Republican challenger in all of California._
I flipped a Republican seat in 2018, and what I’m seeing in Marni’s race reminds me a lot of that. I know what she needs right now is a surge of grassroots support.
**[This race is one of our best opportunities to flip a Republican seat, and we can’t let it go to waste. Split $5 or anything you can afford between Marni’s campaign and Truth to Power to help her win this race and stop Trump in November.](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21531?c0=em_ms_ttp_20260613_1_ak.W7YbYw&refcode=em20260613-41484&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=41484%2E3422442%2EUbxW9O)**

Thank you,
Katie Porter

Former U.S. Congresswoman Katie Porter founded Truth to Power to support the campaigns of her fellow Democrats. Team Nunn ("JFC") is a joint fundraising committee composed of Iowans for Zach Nunn ("Campaign"), Call to Service PAC ("LPAC") and NRCC (each, a "Committee," and, collectively, the "Committees"). Any contribution to the JFC permissible under the Federal Election Campaign Act, as amended ("FECA"), from contributors who have not exceeded their applicable federal contribution limits, shall be allocated among the Committees pursuant to FECA and the formula set forth in this Notice.

_**Contributions Made by an Individual or Federal Non-Multicandidate Political Committee:**_
Individuals or federal non-multicandidate PACs may contribute up to $322,100. Such contributions shall be allocated in the following order:
1\. Campaign shall receive any contribution not exceeding $7,000, designating up to $3,500 to the primary election and up to $3,500 to the general election, provided such limits apply.
2\. LPAC shall receive any contribution not exceeding $5,000 annually.
3\. NRCC shall receive for its general account any contribution not exceeding $44,300 annually.
4\. NRCC shall receive any contribution not to exceed $132,900 for its Building Fund, provided such limits apply.
5\. NRCC shall receive any contribution not to exceed $132,900 for its Legal Proceedings Fund, provided such limits apply.

_**Contributions Made by a Federal Multicandidate Political Committee:**_
Multicandidate PACs may contribute up to $120,000. Such contributions shall be allocated in the following order:
1\. Campaign shall receive any contribution not exceeding $10,000, designating up to $5,000 to the primary election and up to $5,000 to the general election, provided such limits apply.
2\. LPAC shall receive any contribution not exceeding $5,000 annually.
3 .NRCC shall receive for its general account any contribution not exceeding $15,000 annually.
4\. NRCC shall receive any contribution not to exceed $45,000 for its Building Fund, provided such limits apply.
5 .NRCC shall receive any contribution not to exceed $45,000 for its Legal Proceedings Fund, provided such limits apply.

Contributions to Team Nunn, or to any participating Committee individually, are not deductible as charitable donations for federal income tax purposes. Contributions from corporations, labor organizations, national banks, federal government contractors, foreign nationals without green cards, and other federally impermissible sources are prohibited. The contributor's signature designates his or her contribution to the elections described above. Contributions that exceed a donor's contribution limit to a participating Committee shall be reallocated to the remaining Committees according to this allocation formula to the extent permitted by FECA. Any contributor may designate his or her contribution to a specific participant Committee to the extent permitted by FECA. Federal law requires us to use our best efforts to collect and report the name, mailing address, occupation, and name of employer of each individual whose aggregate contributions exceed $200 in an election cycle or calendar year, as applicable.

| | Team Larsen is continuing the momentum with launch week: we're updating our website, refreshing social media, doorbelling, and holding events across the district. **We're excited to share that over 80 current and former local elected officials across Northwest Washington have resoundingly endorsed Rick Larsen for his reelection to Congress.** We're grateful to have earned these endorsements. **As a former Snohomish County Councilmember and lifelong Snohomish County Democrat, Rick understands the importance of local elected officials' work firsthand.** **Their support is critical to ensuring Rick can continue listening to the needs of residents, experts, and local stakeholders and actually**** _deliver_****for Northwest Washington.** With their collaboration, Rick's brought millions of dollars home for infrastructure funding, good-paying jobs, and quality-of-life improvements for residents. Recently, that work accomplished:
* $33.99 million in funding to improve railways, reduce congestion, and move to greener transit options in Snohomish County alone.
* $27.12 million in funding for Skagit County to improve transit and build the Anacortes Community Event Center.
* $3.45 million for Island County to improve Oak Harbor, support the Boys & Girls Club Gymnasium, and invest in the recycling and reuse stations.
* $21.22 million in Whatcom County for greener hybrid buses, the FASST project, and to support Domestic Violence and Sexual Assault Services.
* $6.44 million in investments in San Juan County for trail improvements, investments in the Lopez Island Family Resource Center's Food Center, and replacing the Orcas Senior Center's roof.

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/855fa2d8-ebf4-4e32-8f58-3165af1e6c7d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

---|---|---

> _Never in American history have we had a president so hostile to our democratic traditions. "_
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0b67984f-2f77-46a6-8087-05a2ea045986?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

> _" Rep. Massie's loss yesterday was not only because of massive funding from AIPAC and Trump megadonors. It is the reality that the modern Republican Party is an authoritarian cult. THE LEADER speaks. Everyone follows -- or else."_
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/4f2a0de4-562e-4eba-af6d-3f88e37b3584?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/cdecfc45-c6da-4259-9f21-996a273540f3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

**" Murphy Questions Elise Stefanik On Elon Musk's Nazi Salutes"**

I was proud to join the Democrats as their first base coach!

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. Peter,

Early morning runs through the neighborhood, the sun just starting to rise, and the sound of my sneakers pounding the pavement. clean_body: We need Kurt Alme in the United States Senate. | I have a clear and urgent request for you, Fellow Patriot. We have an open U.S. Senate seat in Montana, and while this seat has long been considered safely Republican, we cannot afford to take anything for granted in this environment. Our Senate map this cycle is challenging. Republicans are defending far more seats than Democrats, and our resources are stretched across the country. Open seats like this one demand early attention and strong grassroots support. Kurt Alme has spent his career serving the people of Montana as a prosecutor, public servant, and leader committed to the rule of law. He served as U.S. Attorney during both Trump Administrations, focusing on public safety, combating drug trafficking, and protecting Montana communities. Now, he's stepping forward to serve again, but he won't have an easy path. Democrats see this race as a top opportunity. They will spend heavily, organize aggressively, and do everything they can to flip this seat. We've seen this playbook before – flooding states with outside money and misleading attacks in an effort to gain control of the Senate. We can't let that happen here. Kurt just got into this race. He needs the resources to introduce himself to voters, share his record, and communicate a clear conservative vision for Montana's future. This race is about more than one seat. It's about maintaining a Senate Republican majority that can advance a conservative agenda, confirm strong judicial nominees, and provide a check on Washington's excesses. If we lose ground here, we risk losing our ability to lead effectively. Kurt Alme is the kind of candidate we need. He's steady, principled, and focused on results. I hope you'll stand with us. John Thune Republican Leader P.S. Montana is a critical hold for Republicans, and this open seat will be a top target for Democrats. [1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Justice Democrat Claire Valdez’s main opponent in New York City’s 7th
congressional district is lying about who’s really backing his campaign.

It’s not grassroots donors supporting him; it’s the real estate lobby —
and he’s trying to hide the truth from voters.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260613-cv.5QjS_u&refcode=em20260613-37904&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=37904%2E1203867%2E_KZKTb ]Tweet by Claire Valdez: Antonio Reynoso just admitted he takes real
estate money, just not from “big” real estate. You be the judge: - $7,000
from NJ power broker and real estate/casino developer Joseph Jacobs. -
$4,000 from Stephen Nislick, an executive at a company that brads about
being “one of the nation’s largest developers of industrial real estate.”
- $7,000 from Daniel McNeil, one of the largest commercial real estate
developers in central New York. - $5,000 from Abe Betesh, who settled a
human rights case with NYC for Section 8 discrimination. - $3,500 from
Michael Ambrosino, indicted for defrauding NY’s 421-a tax break.

These are the corporate developers making housing more expensive and less
accessible for working-class New Yorkers. The same donors who tried to
beat Zohran and elect Andrew Cuomo.

If they’re backing his campaign, you can bet he’ll do their bidding in
Congress.

It gets worse. Right after claiming he opposes super PAC spending, a super
PAC dropped hundreds of thousands of dollars to support him just a day
later.

This is a trend we’re seeing across the country: our opponents are trying
to talk like progressives, but their money trail leads right back to the
same exact corporate interests that have been blocking progress for years.

But Claire is the real deal, and we have to make sure she wins this
primary in just 10 days.

Claire is the only candidate in this primary who isn’t backed by the real
estate lobby. She has never taken a cent of corporate PAC money, so we can
trust her to stand up to the billionaires and corporations rigging the
economy.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260613-cv.5QjS_u&refcode=em20260613-37904&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=1003&akid=37904%2E1203867%2E_KZKTb ]Help us fight back against our opponents who are trying to muddy the
waters and buy this election: split $10 between Claire’s
campaign and Justice Democrats right now to send a true progressive
fighter to Congress in NY-07!

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260613-cv.5QjS_u&refcode=em20260613-37904&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=1022&akid=37904%2E1203867%2E_KZKTb ]Contribute $10

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

Our June mid-month deadline is in just a couple of days, and our team has set a $350,000 goal.
We know you probably get a lot of these kinds of emails around this time of month, so let me give you a quick peek behind the curtain:

name: Chris Brooks, LCV
subject: You helped convince Big Oil not to bid on the Arctic Refuge. THANK YOU.
body:
This is how we build power for people and our planet

If you are unable to see the message below, [click here to view](https://links.messages.lcv.org/servlet/MailView?ms=MTM3ODE5MDYS1&r=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&j=MjQ4MDg0MjkwOQS2&mt=1&rt=0).
| | | |
---
| | |
* * *
---
| | Peter,
---
| | Chris here, reaching out with immense thanks to the **7,326 of you who sent messages to Big Oil last week**. You urged major oil companies not to bid on leases in the irreplaceable Arctic Refuge — _and they didn’t_. This is how we build power for people and our planet.
---
| | The Trump administration’s Arctic Refuge lease sale was a major flop, yielding only 1% of the revenue promised. The sale had only 2 bidders — no major oil companies — and one was the Alaska state-run corporation that stepped in due to lack of competition. Thanks to decades of resistance from the Gwich'in people and sustained pressure from supporters like you, the Arctic Refuge has remained free from oil and gas drilling and development.
---
| | But make no mistake: any oil and gas leasing in the Arctic Refuge has unacceptable risks. LCV will continue to mobilize supporters like you against threats in the Arctic Refuge and give you opportunities to speak out and take action, because nothing justifies selling off one of the last wild places on Earth.
---
| | Thank you for speaking out and for standing with LCV and with all the protectors of the Arctic Refuge — so that this irreplaceable wilderness continues to thrive for future generations.
---
| | With gratitude,
---
| | Chris BrooksVice President, Membership
League of Conservation Voters
---

body:
We're so close, but we need your help to get across the finish line.
| | | | |
---
We wish we had better news to share, Peter:
Roy Cooper is neck-and-neck with President Trump's handpicked candidate, Michael Whatley – **and if we don't hit our $750,000 mid-month goal, we might not have the resources to fight off the GOP's relentless attacks and pull ahead.**
We're so close, but we need your help to get across the finish line. **[Can you please rush $5 or more right now to help us reach our crucial mid-month goal, flip North Carolina blue and take back the Senate from the GOP? Every dollar makes a difference at this pivotal moment in the race.](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk656&amount=5&t=7&akid=1745%2E124072%2EAt8lb6)**
President Trump and JD Vance have rallied the MAGA base behind Whatley, and so far, far-right groups are committing to flood NC with nearly $100 million in attack ads to crush our grassroots movement and _buy_ Whatley this seat.
None of that would be happening if they weren’t terrified that we have what it takes to end their one-party rule over Washington DC – just by running a campaign on $5 and $10 donations from thousands of folks just like you.
**So if we're going to defeat the GOP's dark-money machine the right way, we cannot afford to miss a single grassroots fundraising goal from here on out – including the one coming up in two days.**
Right now, Peter, we're falling seriously behind. **[Please, will you rush a donation of $5, $10 or anything right away? It’s the only way we’ll close the gap in time and keep up the fight to flip both North Carolina’s seat and the Senate majority.](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk656&amount=5&t=8&akid=1745%2E124072%2EAt8lb6)**

Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
Team, this won’t take long.
You know that voting rights are under attack by anti-voting politicians in Congress and in state legislatures across the country. And, you know, the Supreme Court voted to destroy the Voting Rights Act .
Those are just a few reasons why we’ve had to increase our voter registration work year over year.
The good news: It’s working! We’ve registered countless voters since our founding, and we are working hard to reach more Americans than ever.
But the bad news: Our voter registration fund is critically low , and if we can’t catch up, we’ll have to drastically cut back these critical programs in a simply crucial election year.
Team, just $3 can help us register a new voter. Will you step up with $30 or whatever you can today to help register 10 new voters? >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=061326_2&amount=30]

Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.

It’s Heather. I’m personally reaching out to ask you to take your spot on our membership team and become a Down Ballot Defender. _Here’s why:_ 2026 presents our best opportunity in years to create a blue wave in the states. To seize this moment, we need to raise and invest $50 million as part of our movement’s power expansion strategy. When we look back at 2026 and see a nationwide transformation of state power, we will have our Down Ballot Defenders to thank. Howdy Peter! This is Clayton Tucker. I saw you signed up on our website the other day and wanted to send you a quick appreciation note! I hope we can earn your trust and support. To stop monopolies from causing more inflation, we're gonna need to stand up against them. They, and their puppet politicians, will always have organized money behind them; what we need organized people. **Having joined, can you take the next step to help us grow this movement?** Below are some easy steps:
### Step 1: Sign Petitions
The more signatures one of our issue petitions get, the more I know to talk about the issue while out on the campaign trail. While our **Bust Monopolies** once was our most signed petition, **Stop AI Data Centers** recently surpassed it, which tells me to talk more about data centers. My petitions also allow you to leave comments, so you can tell me your personal story about why this issue is important. Check out my issues page here and sign some of my petitions! [https://www.claytontuckertx.com/issues](https://www.claytontuckertx.com/issues?e=a1313c0e9f6a9c38a4fba3102a3a2800&utm_source=cht&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=welcome_online&n=2)
### Step 2: Follow me on Social Media
If you haven't already, please:
1. Follow me on social media! We're on Facebook, Instagram, Threads, X, BlueSky, Substack, TikTok, and LinkedIn.
2. Invite others to follow too!

You can find all the links here: [https://www.claytontuckertx.com/socials](https://www.claytontuckertx.com/socials?e=a1313c0e9f6a9c38a4fba3102a3a2800&utm_source=cht&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=welcome_online&n=3)
